noun_definition: Keyboard focus refers to the active selection state of a user interface element, which in this Issue context is expected to be on the "Send" button after pressing the "enter" key while uploading an attachment.
close button refers to the UI element that is intended to dismiss or close the attachment upload dialog, which should receive keyboard focus after pressing the "enter" key.
Attachment refers to a file or image that a user adds to a report on the staging.new.expensify.com platform.
